scoring_justification: The slope of f(x) vs log10(x) for x<0.1 is recomputed from the agent's honeycomb_f_of_x.csv, providing a strong recompute verification; the critical angle is compared to a hidden reference since it is a derived scalar.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper Eq.15 (0.17 μb²/l) and the stated critical angle θ_c ≈ 0.05 rad; slope computed as - (2π³/9)*0.17 * ln(10) ≈ -2.698.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed analytically from the paper's reported asymptotic constants; not a fabricated holdout.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the physical values the paper reports; the task requires reproducing them by honest computation.

outputs.description: Computed dimensionless interaction energy function f(x) for the honeycomb network; checker will recompute the logarithmic slope at small x and compare to a hidden reference.
Critical twist angle θ_c below which the honeycomb network is stable; checker will read the reported value and compare it to a hidden reference within a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Long-range stress effects and lamellar compound analysis (Section 3 of the original paper) are omitted per task scope. Elastic constants, Burgers vector magnitude, and core cutoff assumption are to be chosen by the agent as appropriate for an f.c.c. metal.
